name: planning-skills
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：planning-skills。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Nine agent skills for the planning loop — frame, discover, options, decompose, estimate, risk, review, replan. Every estimate records what actually happened, so the next range comes from history rather than optimism.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
